hook.name: CurveStableNGAggregator
hook.description: Aggregator hook that fills Uniswap v4 swaps from Curve StableSwap-NG plain pools (stablecoins, ETH and BTC pairs), returning a BeforeSwapDelta so the v4 pool itself holds no liquidity. Exact-output swaps revert with ExactOutputNotSupported. Liquidity provision on the v4 pool is disabled, the hook is immutable and ownerless, and a protocol fee capped by a constant is taken on each swap.
